objects-check.description: Fails when a committed core object (under the runtime/ tree, platform modules included, or services/) is older than its sources. Content-module objects are not read.

options.command: for dir in runtime services; do dist/patchkit/patchkit --root . build --check --tree "$dir" || { echo "A committed object under $dir is stale: run dist/patchkit/patchkit --root . build --tree $dir and commit the result." >&2; exit 1; }; done

repo-check.description: Repository checks that are commands, not tests: every generated file is current (`gen --check`: module, SDK and firmware files, and the row layouts against the assembly that reads them), every service crate follows the service layout and declares what its manifest lists (`service-check`), every item of the runtime object has an owner in owners.toml (`owners`), and every gallery lists the devices of its manifest (`tools/nx/check-gallery.mjs`). Run with the packed patchkit CLI; takes about two seconds.

commands: dirs=; for m in services/*/dks/module.toml; do dirs="$dirs ${m%/dks/module.toml}"; done; dist/patchkit/patchkit --root . service-check $dirs
out=$(mktemp -d) && dist/patchkit/patchkit --root . owners runtime/core/build/runtime.dko.json --owners runtime/core/owners.toml --out "$out" > /dev/null; status=$?; rm -rf "$out"; exit $status

ports.description: The port file (role 2, docs/plans/port-file.md) of every committed port: dist/ports/<device>-<version>.dkport, from ports and ports/fw only (no firmware).

options.command: rm -rf dist/ports && dist/patchkit/patchkit --root . port build --all --out dist/ports

ports-test.description: The port file of the test image: dist/ports-test/<device>-<version>.dkport, as `ports` plus the hooks of the test fixture service (test/svc-test), whose site is a site that image modules patch. Only the test fixtures and the device tests of providers use it; a production port file lists none of them.

options.command: rm -rf dist/ports-test && dist/patchkit/patchkit --root . port build --all --with-test-hooks --out dist/ports-test

sdk-coverage.description: Fails when an [[import]] of sdk/sdk.toml is linked by no packed module and is not in sdk/coverage-allow.toml. Runs after every pack target; not cached (the packs are).

options.command: dist/patchkit/patchkit --root . coverage --sdk sdk/sdk.toml --allow sdk/coverage-allow.toml dist/modules/*/*.dkm dist/modules/*/*.dks

wasm.description: Builds patchkit.wasm, dkupload.wasm and dksample.wasm into apps/web/public/. Its inputs are the Rust crates of patchkit (default, ^production) and the build files; no TypeScript. The cargo wasm build recompiles on every call, so Nx replays it when the inputs are unchanged.
